meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone does not establish a concern. I have the vendor's own guide in my bag saying it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son does not lie, and you just told me he cheated on the strength of a program you call "very reliable." I'm writing that down, word for word. Unless you have something with a date on it, I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record because his mother asked questions, and I'm writing that down too. Your own procedure, 4.4 and 4.5, puts nothing on file for a first concern, so check your own policy before you say "permanent record" to me again. Is there a document, Hale, or am I going upstairs?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, and she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because it attacked Owen with no document behind it and confirmed her belief that the school punishes first.
Try next time: when she first asked "Who decided that, and on what basis?", own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her a dated document from Owen's own work instead of the 94% score.
